blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Cebuano table tennis standouts Eljay Tormis and Mikylla Dinauanao kept their respective teams’ title hopes alive after securing semifinal berths in the singles event of the UAAP Season 89 Collegiate Table Tennis Championships on Saturday, November 14, at Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City.
